name: Essential Properties Realty Trust
outlook:
What Essential Properties Realty Trust says to expect

  • Full year 2027: AFFO per share, volume, cash G&AThe Company currently expects 2027 AFFO per share on a fully diluted basis to be within a range of $2.10 to $2.18. The guidance range includes an estimate for investment volume of $1.0 billion to $1.5 billion, and Cash G&A expense of $32.0 million to $37.0 million.
  • Full year 2026: AFFO per share and investment volumeThe Company is increasing its previously issued 2026 AFFO per share estimate from $2.01 to $2.05 to a new range of $2.02 to $2.05. The Company is also increasing its guidance range for 2026 investment volume from $1.2 billion to $1.5 billion to an updated range of $1.3 billion to $1.5 billion, and is reiterating its prior guidance range for 2026 Cash G&A of $30.0 million to $34.0 million.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed October 21, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
